failure_classes.description: The predicted mathematical signature was not detected in the dataset.
The observed signature was statistically indistinguishable from the null-model control.
Falsification protocols (e.g., shuffle) produced stronger signatures than the primary data.
Proxy metrics failed to achieve numerical stability across analysis iterations.

governance_rules.rule: Negative and null results must be indexed with equal priority to supportive findings.

required_statement: Observed signatures are interpreted only through restricted local analog structure.
